recommendations.action: Prioritise signal maintenance / CBTC inspection on the approach segment
recommendations.rationale: Signal alerts coincide with problem arrivals; recurring signal faults on one segment are usually a component issue.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removes the recurring gap source; typical APT reduction equals the segment's median excess run time.

recommendations.action: Schedule rail-condition inspection / grinding on the approach segment
recommendations.rationale: Track alerts (rail condition, track fire, debris) over-index at this location.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removes speed restrictions and the associated run-time excess.

recommendations.action: Review car-class reliability for 1, 2, 3; pull chronic door/brake defects from peak assignments
recommendations.rationale: Mechanical alerts correlate with problem arrivals.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer disabled trains blocking the line.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for 1, 2, 3; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for 1, 2, 3; add supplement trains or move work windows off 02:00-03:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Pre-position a signal maintainer during 02:00-03:00 on days with active work orders
recommendations.rationale: Response time dominates the delay length for signal failures.
recommendations.expected_effect: Shorter incident duration, fewer 50+ train major incidents.

recommendations.action: Coordinate planned track work windows to avoid 02:00-03:00
recommendations.rationale: Work windows overlapping busy hours amplify passenger impact.

recommendations.action: Stage a spare train set near Harlem-148 St during 02:00-03:00
recommendations.rationale: A ready spare turns a 20-minute gap into a 5-minute one.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the size of mechanical-caused gaps.

recommendations.action: During 02:00-03:00, check alerts for '1, 2, 3' before entering; use the alternate routes other lines at the station when a signal alert is posted
recommendations.rationale: Signal-caused gaps last tens of minutes; alternates are usually unaffected.
